unchanged-condition.reason: The shell condition is the same text.

checked-same.reason: The same condition judges one checked read or one local state receipt.

missing-is-unavailable.reason: A missing element, height or AXValue is unavailable. It is not a false state or an empty value.

classified-outcome.reason: A failed return keeps its condition and reports a named outcome class with the list that it judged.

exact-menu-list.reason: The comparison uses the title list instead of the joined text, so a comma in a title cannot match another menu.

restart-classification.reason: A restart that does not return is a test-driver or guest failure, never a Koine failure.

message-only.reason: The failure text changes. The action, wait, bound and predicate do not.

no-corrective-input.reason: After a failed assertion, no corrective input follows, so the failure evidence shows the state that the assertion judged.

keepalive-removed.reason: The harness takes no keepalive captures.

caller-owns-stop.reason: The finite caller owns the exact stop, the inventory and the collection.

refused-diagnostic-write.reason: The ordering protocol permits no enabling diagnostic write.

strict-one-attempt.reason: Each transport is one strict attempt. A failed attempt is unavailable and is never retried.

added-observation.reason: The protocol adds reads and failure observations between existing inputs. It adds no input or wait.

reviewed-harness-change.reason: The prefix report records this harness change and its reason.

KOINE_SETTINGS_TRACE=1 defaults write is now a refusal
The twelve-attempt guest retry and the repeated port read are now one attempt
Count-poll failure messages are now an outcome class with the judged list
Every failed assertion now takes an observer read and a window read before its screenshot
Front-check messages now name the judged list
TextEdit quit is now strict, with one absence read and an assertion
A failed held point sends no best-effort release in strict mode
A minimum content read with no element or height is now unavailable
A field value after the cut with no AXValue is now unavailable
The request-label echo is now a required value read
A refused restart read now stops at once
The port read now asserts that the descriptor is present
The background-only echo now follows its assertion
The read_frame failure message no longer prints the entry
A click on a vanished element reports an undelivered click
